sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:100

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:100:1
items.html: There is also an Ibur in the matter of these Mochin of the GAR [first three] of Gadlut: Our intention is the second coupling within the second Ibur, made through the raising of MAN [Mayin Nukvin] when he is nine years and one day old. And it has already been explained that this is not a separate Ibur, for there are no more than two Iburs: the first Ibur is through the upper one, in that the upper one raises him as MAN, by the power of the GE of the lower one that are attached to the AHP of the upper one, for then he rises from within the shells that are in BYA, and he is unable to rise as MAN by himself. And the second Ibur is after the two years of nursing, when he rises as MAN by himself. And all the couplings after this are also called by the name second Ibur, as above at length.
